title: Boston fair housing bar on discrimination against renters using rental assistance
requirement: In Boston it is illegal for a landlord to discriminate when renting housing, including by refusing to rent to a tenant because the tenant uses rental assistance such as Section 8, social security disability, or veterans vouchers.
coverage_conditions: All housing rented, bought, sold, or financed in the City of Boston; the commission investigates complaints under local, state, and federal fair housing laws.

applicability.per_tenancy: Covered for any renter or buyer in Boston who uses rental assistance, including Section 8 vouchers, social security disability vouchers, and veterans vouchers.
coverage_quotes: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.

quoted_span:
